result.quote: If we say, ‘Let us go into the city,’ we will die there from the famine in the city; but if we sit here, we will also die. So come now, let us go over to the camp of the Arameans. If they let us live, we will live; if they kill us, we will die.
result.reason: Verse 7:4 directly supports every part of the key: entering the famine-stricken city or remaining at the gate meant death, while going to the Arameans offered a possibility of survival. The question clearly asks for the men’s reason for going, and the edit preserves the original intended fact while making the wording precise and natural.
